results.name: parcels_new_valmeyer
results.title: parcels_new_valmeyer
results.description:
The old location of Valmeyer, IL was located in the Mississippi River floodplain and was at risk for flooding. Monroe County decided to move the town and this GIS layer represents the location data for parcels in the new Valmeyer, IL location. This GIS layer shows parcel property boundaries and locations including data for minimum, maximum and mean elevation and slope for each parcel. This GIS layer also features mean distance of each parcel from the old Valmeyer town location.

Geoprocessing and data acquisition:

The GIS parcel feature class that was used as the base for this GIS layer was provided by the UC Davis Specialization course through Coursera. It is unclear what date and from where the original GIS parcel feature class was received. After receiving the GIS parcel feature class, the following was conducted by Angelica Amesquita to append the data on March 20 and 21, 2024.

Digital elevation model (DEM) raster data for parcels at 10m x 10m cell sizes were provided by the UC Davis GIS Specialization program for this assignment. The DEM_10m raster data was resampled for 5m x 5m cell sizes (DEM_5m) in order to obtain mean, minimum and maximum elevation data for each parcel. Mean, minimum and maximum elevation data, measured in meters, for parcels was calculated using the Zonal Statistics as Table geoprocessing tool. These data were added to the parcel layer using the Add Join feature, joining with parcel Object IDs.

The DEM_5m raster data was also used to generate a Slope_5m raster for the parcels. The slope raster was represented in degrees and was used to calculate mean, maximum and minimum degree slope data for each parcel using the Zonal Statistics as Table geoprocessing tool. These data were added to the parcel layer using the Add Join feature, joining with parcel Object IDs.

The mean distance of each parcel (move_dist), measured in meters, to the old Valmeyer location was calculated using the Euclidean Distance geoprocessing tools. In this analysis, the maximum distance was set to 5000, an output cell size of 10m, and the "Snap Raster" and "Extent" environmental variables were set to the DEM_10m raster data. These data were resampled at 5m and were then added to the parcel layer using the Add Join feature, joining with parcel Object IDs.
results.snippet: This feature class provides data for parcels in the new location of Valmeyer, a town in Illinois. It was created to update parcel information for the assessor's office of Monroe County, Illinois and for the state department of emergency management.
results.licenseInfo: This GIS layer was created for use as part of the UC Davis GIS Specialization certificate course through Coursera.
results.source: UC Davis Continuing and Professional Education

results.name: Moving_Valmeyer_and_Road_Network_Monroe_County
results.title: Moving Valmeyer and Road Network Monroe County
results.description: This digitized roads layer was created as part of a project to update the GIS infrastructure for New Valmeyer after the town was relocated from its original flood-prone site. The lines represent the approximate locations of roads between the new parcels, providing a temporary road network to aid emergency management and local planning authorities. The roads layer will be further refined with street names, address ranges, and additional details by local authorities at a later stage.
results.snippet: This layer represents the approximate road network for the relocated town of New Valmeyer, Monroe County, Illinois. The road lines were digitized based on the new parcel layout following the town’s move to higher ground after repeated flooding in the Mississippi River floodplain. This map provides an essential framework for routing emergency vehicles and public services in the new town. Roads are not exact but provide a general layout for planning purposes. This data will be updated with more precise information when available.
results.source: UC Davis Continuing and Professional Education

results.name: Map_Moving_Valmeyer_Hanif
results.title: Map Moving Valmeyer_Hanif
results.snippet: This web map presents the 2025 GIS analysis of Valmeyer's relocation from the Mississippi River floodplain to higher ground in Monroe County, Illinois. It includes spatial data for old and new parcel boundaries, elevation and slope statistics, average distance moved by each parcel, and a newly digitized road network in the new town area. The project supports emergency management and planning efforts by visualizing key geospatial factors involved in community relocation.
results.source: UC Davis Continuing and Professional Education

mean_elev - This is the mean elevation in meters

min_slope - This is the minimum slope in degrees

max_slope - This is the maximum slope in degrees

mean_slope - This is the mean slope in degrees

move_dist - This is the mean distance from Old Valmeyer in meters
